The image focuses on the soleplate and the side profile of the iron's body. The soleplate features a distinct pattern of green-rimmed steam holes. The handle and upper body are visible but slightly out of focus in the background. A power cord is partially visible at the rear base.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'green' steam holes. In real irons, these are usually just empty holes in metal/ceramic. Colored rings might indicate a specific model, but often in AI images, colored holes are a textural hallucination. Verify if the holes look like physical voids or flat decals. Also, scrutinize the handle area hidden by blur—does the topology make sense, or is it a vague lump?
